# Blocks and switching

Hearts and Flowers has three blocks: hearts (press on the same side),
flowers (press on the opposite side) and a mixed block. Trials are the first
of a block (start), a repeat of the previous rule (stay) or, in the mixed
block, a change of rule (switch). Responses faster than 200 ms or slower
than 2 seconds count as wrong.

```{r hf-trials}
hf <- trials |>
  mutate(block = recode(item_group, hearts = "Hearts", flowers = "Flowers",
                        heartsflowers = "Mixed"),
         trial_type = str_extract(item_uid, "(start|stay|switch)$"),
         age_band = cut(age_at_run(run_id), c(3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 16), right = FALSE,
                        labels = c("3–4", "5–6", "7–8", "9–10", "11+")))
```

```{r hf-blocks, fig.height=4.5}
#| label: fig-hf-blocks
#| fig-cap: "Accuracy by block, trial type and age (all runs)."
hf |>
  filter(!is.na(age_band), !is.na(trial_type)) |>
  group_by(block, trial_type, age_band) |>
  summarise(accuracy = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age_band, y = accuracy, colour = trial_type, group = trial_type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, lty = 2, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(vars(block)) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Accuracy") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r hf-switch-cost}
switch_cost <- hf |>
  filter(block == "Mixed", trial_type %in% c("stay", "switch"), !is.na(age_band)) |>
  group_by(age_band, trial_type) |>
  summarise(accuracy = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = trial_type, values_from = accuracy) |>
  mutate(cost = stay - switch)
```

In the mixed block, switch trials are
`r if (all(switch_cost$cost > 0)) "less accurate than stay trials at every age" else "not less accurate than stay trials at every age"`;
the difference is `r f2(max(switch_cost$cost))` at
`r switch_cost$age_band[which.max(switch_cost$cost)]` and
`r f2(min(switch_cost$cost))` at
`r switch_cost$age_band[which.min(switch_cost$cost)]`.

```{r hf-timing, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-hf-timing
#| fig-cap: "Share of responses outside the 200–2,000 ms window, by block and age; these count as wrong."
hf |>
  filter(!is.na(age_band)) |>
  group_by(block, age_band) |>
  summarise(too_slow = mean(rt_numeric > 2000 | is.na(rt_numeric)),
            too_fast = mean(rt_numeric < 200, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(c(too_slow, too_fast), names_to = "kind", values_to = "share") |>
  mutate(kind = recode(kind, too_slow = "slower than 2 s or no response",
                       too_fast = "faster than 200 ms")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age_band, y = share, colour = block, group = block)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(vars(kind)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Share of responses") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

# Open issues

- Which form a child receives follows the task variant, not the code
  version; the redesign that added a feedback sound and faster mixed blocks
  is evaluated in the
  [Hearts and Flowers v2 study](../studies/2026-10_hf-v2-redesign/hearts_and_flowers_v2.qmd).
- Scores pile up near the top of the range in some datasets (see Scores
  above and the [growth page checks](../monitor/growth.qmd#fig-trajectory-checks)).
- Production scores the task with a Rasch model with a .5 guessing floor;
  an earlier claim that a 2PL model fits better is
  [retracted](../register/index.qmd).
